title: DISPARITIES IN NEGATION UNDERSTANDING ACROSS LANGUAGES IN VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing vision-language model (VLM) top-1 accuracy on a 4-way caption ranking task for negated queries across seven typologically diverse languages to measure cross-lingual performance gaps and inequitable service quality.
Testing vision-language models on a negated image-caption benchmark to measure their systematic tendency to incorrectly select positive captions instead of the correct negated descriptions.
